label: Agent 应用
def: 开箱即用、直接拿来用的 Agent / 聊天产品

subs.label: 个人 AI 助理
subs.def: 常驻运行在自己机器上、通过 IM 等多渠道触达的个人 Agent
subs.def_en: Always-on personal agents running on your own machine, reachable through IM and other channels

subs.label: 通用 / 研究型 Agent
subs.def: 给一个目标即可自主规划执行的通用 Agent（Manus 类、深度研究类）
subs.def_en: Agents that plan and execute autonomously from a single goal (Manus-style, deep research)

subs.label: GUI 操控 Agent
subs.def: 看屏幕、点界面，操作电脑 / 手机 / 网页的 Agent
subs.def_en: Agents that see the screen and operate computers, phones, or web pages

subs.label: 聊天客户端
subs.def: 对接各家模型 API 或本地模型的聊天界面与桌面端
subs.def_en: Chat interfaces and desktop apps for model APIs or local models

label: 编码 Agent 生态
def: 编码 Agent 本体，以及围绕 Claude Code / Codex 等的周边工具

subs.label: 编码 Agent
subs.def: 终端 / IDE 里读代码、改代码、跑命令的 Agent 本体
subs.def_en: Agents in the terminal or IDE that read code, edit code, and run commands

subs.label: 多 Agent 工作台
subs.def: 同时调度多个编码 Agent，按任务 / 看板 / 工作流协作
subs.def_en: Orchestrate several coding agents by task, kanban, or workflow

subs.label: 客户端与配置增强
subs.def: 给现有编码 Agent 加 GUI、终端、HUD、移动端、配置模板、供应商切换
subs.def_en: GUIs, terminals, HUDs, mobile clients, config templates, and provider switching for existing coding agents

subs.label: 代码理解与评审
subs.def: 代码知识图谱、代码库打包、最新文档注入、自动代码评审
subs.def_en: Code knowledge graphs, repo packing, up-to-date docs injection, and automated code review

def_en: Coding agents themselves, plus tooling built around Claude Code, Codex, and similar

label: Agent 技能与方法论
def: 装进现有 Agent 的 Skills / 插件 / 工作流规范

subs.label: 开发方法论
subs.def: 规范驱动开发、多角色流程等成体系的 Agent 工作方法
subs.def_en: Structured agent workflows such as spec-driven development and multi-role processes

subs.label: 工程实践技能
subs.def: 编码习惯、规划、输出风格、安全审计等通用工程技能
subs.def_en: General engineering skills: coding habits, planning, output style, security audits

subs.label: 设计与内容技能
subs.def: UI 审美、图表、PPT、动效、配图、文案去 AI 味
subs.def_en: UI taste, diagrams, slides, motion, illustrations, and de-AI-ifying prose

subs.label: 行业与知识工作技能
subs.def: 科研、营销、产品、安全、人物蒸馏等领域技能包
subs.def_en: Skill packs for research, marketing, product, security, persona distillation, and more

subs.label: 技能库与插件市场
subs.def: 官方技能库、插件目录、技能合集清单与技能管理工具
subs.def_en: Official skill libraries, plugin directories, skill collections, and skill managers

def_en: Skills, plugins, and workflow conventions that plug into existing agents

label: Agent 开发框架与平台
def: 自己动手搭 Agent / LLM 应用用的框架、平台和协议

subs.label: 代码框架 / SDK
subs.def: 用代码构建 Agent 与 LLM 应用的框架和 SDK
subs.def_en: Frameworks and SDKs for building agents and LLM apps in code

subs.label: 低代码 / 工作流平台
subs.def: 可视化编排 Agent、RAG 与自动化流程的平台
subs.def_en: Visual platforms for orchestrating agents, RAG, and automation

subs.label: 协议与格式规范
subs.def: MCP、A2A、AGENTS.md、SKILL.md 等开放协议、规范及其官方 SDK
subs.def_en: Open protocols, specs, and their official SDKs: MCP, A2A, AGENTS.md, SKILL.md

subs.label: 多智能体仿真
subs.def: 让大量 Agent / 模型互动来模拟社会、推演趋势或群体决策
subs.def_en: Large numbers of agents or models interacting to simulate societies, forecast trends, or reach group decisions

def_en: Frameworks, platforms, and protocols for building agents and LLM apps yourself

label: Agent 基础组件
def: 给 Agent 补上记忆、手脚和运行环境的组件

subs.label: 记忆与上下文
subs.def: 跨会话持久记忆、知识图谱记忆、上下文数据库
subs.def_en: Persistent cross-session memory, knowledge-graph memory, context databases

subs.label: Token 压缩
subs.def: 在内容进入上下文前做压缩 / 过滤，降低 token 消耗
subs.def_en: Compress or filter content before it enters the context window to cut token cost

subs.label: 浏览器自动化
subs.def: 给 Agent 用的浏览器、无头浏览器与浏览器操控 SDK
subs.def_en: Browsers, headless browsers, and browser-control SDKs built for agents

subs.label: MCP 与工具接入
subs.def: MCP 服务器、工具集成平台、面向 Agent 的 CLI
subs.def_en: MCP servers, tool-integration platforms, and agent-friendly CLIs

subs.label: 沙箱与运行时
subs.def: 隔离执行 AI 生成代码 / Agent 的安全环境
subs.def_en: Isolated environments for running AI-generated code and agents safely

def_en: Components that give agents memory, hands, and a runtime

label: 数据与检索
def: 把外部数据变成 LLM 可用上下文：抓取、解析、检索

subs.label: RAG 与知识库
subs.def: 检索增强生成引擎、文档问答与企业知识库
subs.def_en: Retrieval-augmented generation engines, document Q&A, and enterprise knowledge bases

subs.label: 向量数据库
subs.def: 向量存储与相似度检索
subs.def_en: Vector storage and similarity search

subs.label: 网页抓取
subs.def: 把网页 / 社媒内容抓成 LLM 可读的 Markdown / JSON
subs.def_en: Turn web pages and social content into LLM-readable Markdown or JSON

subs.label: 文档解析
subs.def: PDF / Office 等文件转 Markdown、结构化信息抽取
subs.def_en: PDF and Office files to Markdown, plus structured information extraction

subs.label: 数据分析 / Text-to-SQL
subs.def: 用自然语言查询数据库与表格
subs.def_en: Query databases and tables in natural language

def_en: Turning external data into LLM-ready context: crawling, parsing, retrieval

subs.label: 开源模型
subs.def: 开源权重的基座 / 推理 / 代码 / 多模态模型
subs.def_en: Open-weight base, reasoning, coding, and multimodal models

subs.label: 本地推理
subs.def: 在个人电脑 / 端侧设备上跑模型的引擎与工具
subs.def_en: Engines and tools for running models on personal computers and edge devices

subs.label: 推理服务与加速
subs.def: 高吞吐推理服务引擎与底层注意力加速
subs.def_en: High-throughput inference serving engines and low-level attention acceleration

subs.label: 训练与微调
subs.def: 预训练、微调、强化学习后训练与模型改造
subs.def_en: Pre-training, fine-tuning, RL post-training, and model modification

subs.label: API 网关与中转
subs.def: 统一多家模型 API、路由转发、订阅中转
subs.def_en: Unify multiple model APIs, route requests, and relay subscriptions

subs.label: 观测、评测与 Prompt 管理
subs.def: LLM 应用的链路追踪、评测、红队与 Prompt 优化
subs.def_en: Tracing, evaluation, red-teaming, and prompt optimization for LLM apps

def_en: Models themselves, and the infrastructure for training, inference, access, and observability

subs.def_en: Stock picking, investment research, quantitative trading

subs.def: 视频、PPT、设计稿、社媒内容的生成与分发
subs.def_en: Generating and distributing video, slides, designs, and social content

subs.label: 安全与渗透测试

subs.def_en: Autonomous penetration testing and vulnerability validation

subs.label: 搜索、情报与舆情
subs.def: AI 搜索引擎、新闻热点与舆情监控
subs.def_en: AI search engines, news trends, and public-opinion monitoring
